title: Caught
steps: Almost there: the way down to the dormitory is just ahead.
Suddenly Dask steps out of the dark in front of you. Caught.
What are three first-years doing out of bed at this hour?
We were only checking the slab that comes and goes, sir! To make sure it did not get lost in the dark!
Dask looks at the three of you for a long moment in silence. Then the smallest of smiles comes to his face.
I have been watching you. You looked before every step, you waited, you lit the dark: very clever work. I shall let you go, just this once, {wizard}.

He walks away up the corridor, and the three of you go on through the arch. Safe under the blankets, you remember what you learned tonight. You counted the cells and asked where things are with `position`. You used a question, an expression, to know whether it was safe, and you chose your way with `if` and `else`. You repeated your steps with the loop `for` and you waited with the loop `while`. And you know two more spells: *kirra*, which lights the dark, and *osto*, which holds what moves. With the secret the three of you now share, you fall asleep at last. The castle is home now.
